title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 13 September 2026
description: Today: a major AI-agent attack campaign compromises 440+ PaperCut servers worldwide while sandbox flaws surface in leading AI coding tools; Australia weighs new gambling-ad reforms and a coastal flood-risk study; Queensland lands the Wallaroos and Rugby Sevens; and the Gold Coast's Coolangatta light rail extension is reportedly scrapped amid rapid population growth. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
